svg.title: What a Letta agent sees
svg.desc: Left, the prompt that the agent reads on every model call, in order: Letta's base instructions, the memory blocks (persona and human), the memory metadata, and the messages of the current conversation with any tool calls and results; the descriptions of the three tools are sent with it. The agent edits the blocks with memory_insert and memory_replace. Right, outside the prompt: recall, every message of every conversation, reached only by calling conversation_search, whose results come back into the conversation. Below, the first call of a session in the notebook, to scale: 2,294 tokens, of which the tool descriptions are 1,594, the base instructions 336, the blocks 225, the metadata 91 and the user's message 48.
svg.text: The prompt is the agent's main memory: the only thing the model sees. Everything else is outside it, like a disk, and comes
in only through a tool call.
rebuilt and sent on every model call
the same for every agent of this type
persona and human: the agent's own memory, edited with tools
ids, a timestamp, how many messages are in recall
its messages, and the tool calls and results of this turn
Sent with it: the descriptions of three tools
the first call of a session in the notebook: 2,294 tokens
The tool descriptions are the largest part: the server copies each tool's examples into its description. Everything but the message is sent again on
every call, including every call inside one turn.
Layout: Letta 0.16.8. Tokens: notebooks/04-letta.ipynb, session 1, first call
